comment: The default candidates of step 6e, ported from a rehearsal with a real founder. Each is a few valid options for one foundation; a candidates file may replace the options of any of them. The values are the keys of the token contract.

foundations.name: Body size
foundations.why: The size of everything people read. The web's usual body size is 16 px; 17 or 18 read more easily on a phone.

cands.name: 17 px
cands.note: A touch larger: easy on phones.

cands.name: 18 px
cands.note: Generous: relaxed, fewer words per line.

foundations.name: Type scale
foundations.why: How much each heading level grows from the text. A small step keeps headings calm; a large one makes headlines.

cands.name: Gentle (1.2)
cands.note: Headings close to the text: calm.

foundations.name: Line height
foundations.why: The space between lines of text. The accessibility guidelines ask that text still works at 1.5.

foundations.name: Spacing
foundations.why: The steps every gap and margin is built from.

foundations.name: Corners
foundations.why: How round the corners of cards, fields, buttons and images are.

foundations.name: Depth
foundations.why: Whether things sit on the page or float above it.

foundations.name: Motion
foundations.why: How things move when they appear or change. Every option stops moving for people who ask their device for reduced motion.

foundations.name: Focus
foundations.why: The ring that shows where the keyboard is. It must reach 3:1 against the page and the cards.

cands.name: Text ring
cands.note: 2 px in the text colour: the strongest contrast.

cands.name: Strong ring
cands.note: 3 px in the accent colour, easier to see.

foundations.name: Touch size
foundations.why: The smallest height of a button or link to tap. The guidelines ask for at least 24 px; 44 px is easier.

foundations.name: Breakpoints
foundations.why: Where the layout changes from phone to tablet to wide screen.

looks.name: Light and airy
looks.note: Generous size and space, round and gentle.

looks.name: Warm and soft
looks.note: Comfortable everywhere, soft corners and a faint lift.

looks.name: Playful
looks.note: Pills, bigger headlines and a bounce.
